definitions.explanation: A road built and maintained by the national government and identified by a number, such as {国道|こくどう}1{号|ごう}. Most are ordinary roads with traffic lights, not expressways.

examples.japanese: {国道|こくどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: To drive along the national highway.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国道|こくどう}1{号線|ごうせん}だ。

{国道|こくどう}{沿|ぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Shops with big parking lots line the national highway.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国道|こくどう}〜{号|ごう} / 〜{号線|ごうせん}: Route ~
- {国道|こくどう}{沿|ぞ}い: along the highway
- {国道|こくどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to come out onto the highway

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧: expressway, a toll road without traffic lights. A {国道|こくどう} is usually an ordinary road, free to use.
- {県道|けんどう}: prefectural road, maintained by the prefecture.
